component.name: Enjambre
component.summary: Download torrents and watch videos while they download

description.p: Enjambre is a torrent client with a built-in player: watch videos while they download.

ul.li: Play video and audio files while they download, with subtitles and audio track selection
Pick which files of a torrent to download
Organize torrents with labels, search, sort and filter them
Speed limits and a limit on active downloads
Keeps downloading in the background, and notifies when a download completes
Available on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and iOS
Built on Transmission for low CPU and memory usage
